schema.text: During the day, how safe do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?
schema.help: We ask this to understand how safe people feel while travelling. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: I don't feel safe at all

en.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: During the day, how safe do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?
en.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: We ask this to understand how safe people feel while travelling. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.
en.#I don't feel safe at all: I don't feel safe at all

it.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Di giorno, quanto ti senti al sicuro da criminalità o molestie durante il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Lo chiediamo per capire quanto le persone si sentono al sicuro durante gli spostamenti. Rispondere è facoltativo e la tua risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.
it.#I don't feel safe at all: Non mi sento per niente al sicuro
it.#I feel completely safe: Mi sento del tutto al sicuro

fr.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Pendant la journée, à quel point vous sentez-vous en sécurité face à la criminalité ou au harcèlement lors de votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre à quel point les gens se sentent en sécurité lors de leurs déplacements. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n’est pas liée à votre nom.
fr.#I don't feel safe at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en sécurité
fr.#I feel slightly safe: Je me sens un peu en sécurité
fr.#I feel moderately safe: Je me sens moyennement en sécurité
fr.#I feel very safe: Je me sens très en sécurité
fr.#I feel completely safe: Je me sens totalement en sécurité

de.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich tagsüber auf Ihrem üblichen Weg vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?
de.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, wie sicher sich Menschen unterwegs fühlen. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.
de.#I don't feel safe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht sicher

tr.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Gündüzleri olağan yolculuğunuzda suça veya tacize karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Bunu, insanların yolculuk sırasında kendilerini ne kadar güvende hissettiklerini anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.

fa.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: در طول روز، در سفر معمول خود چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم مردم هنگام رفت‌وآمد چقدر احساس امنیت می‌کنند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود.

hu.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Napközben mennyire érzi magát biztonságban bűncselekményekkel vagy zaklatással szemben a szokásos útja során?
hu.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mennyire érzik magukat biztonságban az emberek közlekedés közben. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és a válasza nincs összekapcsolva a nevével.

ar.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: خلال النهار، إلى أي مدى تشعر بالأمان من الجريمة أو التحرش في تنقّلك المعتاد؟
ar.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم مدى شعور الناس بالأمان أثناء تنقلهم. الإجابة اختيارية وإجابتك غير مرتبطة باسمك.
